mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.reported_user_id AS reportedUserId, target.name AS reportedUserName, target.email AS reportedUserEmail, r.report_user_id AS reportUserId, reporter.name AS reportUserName, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.category AS category, r.detail AS detail, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.status AS status, r.processed_by AS processedBy, r.processed_at AS processedAt, r.process_reason AS processReason, r.login_restriction_days AS loginRestrictionDays FROM report r LEFT JOIN member target ON target.user_id = r.reported_user_id LEFT JOIN member reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.report_user_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = 'LOGIN_RESTRICTED', processed_by = #{adminUserId}, processed_at = NOW(), process_reason = #{reason}, login_restriction_days = #{days} WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE report SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', processed_by = #{adminUserId}, processed_at = NOW(), process_reason = #{reason}, login_restriction_days = NULL WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE report SET status = 'DISMISSED', processed_by = #{adminUserId}, processed_at = NOW(), process_reason = #{reason}, login_restriction_days = NULL WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE member SET login_restriction_days = #{days}, login_restricted_at = NOW(), login_restricted_until = #{restrictedUntil}, login_restriction_reason = #{reason}, login_restricted_by = #{adminUserId} WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId} AND deleted = 1

UPDATE member SET deleted = 0, withdrawn_at = NOW(), login_restriction_days = 0, login_restricted_at = NULL, login_restricted_until = NULL, login_restriction_reason = NULL, login_restricted_by = NULL WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_admin_action_history ( target_user_id, admin_user_id, report_id, action_type, action_reason, before_value, after_value, created_at ) VALUES ( #{targetUserId}, #{adminUserId}, #{reportId}, #{actionType}, #{actionReason}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, NOW() )
